scope: Scene01 foreground hexagonal hanging lantern and all caps of the existing near balustrade; layout124-d stair/landing and group positions retained.

geometry.authorship: Original analytic geometry authored for this reconstruction
parts: Six flat pierced floral/fret screens, 33 true apertures per face, in assembled wooden stiles and rails
Closed sharp hexagonal roof and sill castings, stepped crown, corner ridges and hanging ears
Actual ceiling intersection, mounting plate, screws, interlinked chain, crown eye and terminal pendant
Shared closed fluted lotus/giboshi core, ten-repeat embossed vegetal band, retaining ledges and rivets
geometry.referenceUse: Visual contour, proportion and construction comparison only

metalMicroSurface.method: Deterministic procedural grayscale micro-pitting, scratches, roughness and fibrous inner glazing; no external raster or generative image

woodMicroSurface.reuse: Existing diffuse, normal and roughness maps with member-aligned physical UVs; local lantern finish only
